title: The New Student and the Hook with a Name
youtube_title: The New Student and the Hook with a Name | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friends can change the plan so both can play.
summary: At a ferry deck with a rail and two elbows of room, Yuri is just outside the fun, close to an empty hook where a name could be written. Farah changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Yuri has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Neighbor Sami lets the children solve it.
